Container.Name: igab-api
Container.Overview: IGAB (I've Got A Budget) API server — the FastAPI backend of the self-hosted envelope-budgeting app. Runs database migrations automatically on start. Requires a PostgreSQL 16 container (name it igab-db on the same custom Docker network) and is fronted by the igab-web container, which serves the UI and proxies /api to this container. See https://github.com/brentonmallen1/IGAB/blob/main/docs/unraid.md for full setup.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: SQLAlchemy async URL of the paired PostgreSQL container. Keep the postgres container named igab-db on the igab network and only change the password here to match it.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: REQUIRED - JWT signing secret; the app refuses to start without a strong value. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Admin Email
Config.Description: Login email for the admin user, created on first run.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: REQUIRED - initial admin password; the app refuses to start on a default/empty value.

Config.Name: SimpleFIN Encryption Key
Config.Description: Optional - only needed for SimpleFIN bank sync. Fernet key; generate with: python3 -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"

Config.Name: Ollama Host
Config.Description: Optional - URL of an Ollama server for AI receipt scanning / natural-language entry (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434). Also configurable in-app under Settings.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Backup archive folder, shared with the igab-backup container. Point this at the array (NOT the same pool/disk as the postgres data) so a dead cache drive can't take the database and its backups together.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Optional - only needed for direct API access from outside Docker (debugging). The igab-web container reaches the API over the igab network without this mapping.
